explanationMd: Compute the rates separately: Ledger: 96/120=80%; Stock: 144/180=80%; Payroll: 270/300=90%. Compare these proportions rather than raw successful counts. The highest rate is 90%.

distractorRationale.d: Compare each numerator with its own denominator. The rates are 80%, 80%, 90%; this claim does not identify all and only the highest-rate categories.
